Plugin.Name: Fejes Mover Monitor
Plugin.Overview: RC1 release candidate. Hungarian, US English and German Mover dashboard and open-file monitor for Unraid 7.x. Observer mode by default. Advanced mode adds opt-in age-filtered native movement for cache/Filmek to the array, skipping young, incomplete, active and open content, with SHA-256 and metadata verification. Selective movement is currently limited to the reviewed local setup: a pool named cache, Filmek share, existing Filmek_Mover_Threshold User Scripts automation, binhex-qbittorrentvpn qBittorrent container, and torrent paths under /mnt/user. Other setups should use Observer mode. Unraid 8 compatibility is unverified. Installation never starts movement or creates a schedule. Peer upload is verified only in the documented disposable 16 MiB component test; tracker seed credit, NAS reboot persistence and broad compatibility remain unverified. Release candidate; keep backups. Eligible files use ratio-priority groups, then larger files first within each group. Existing file/byte limits and maintenance guards remain mandatory. Validation record (2026-11-10): real torrent recheck and a complete 16 MiB internal peer transfer passed after native component movement, with matching SHA-256 and upload/download byte counts. Eligibility preflight was simulated; full guarded-runner acceptance remains pending. Evidence: https://github.com/fejesgabortorrent-dot/unraid-fejes-mover-monitor/blob/main/docs/SEED-COMPONENT-RESULT-20261110.md
